body.x: GYEONGGI, Korea (AVING Special Report on 'KES 2007') -- <Visual News> Sony presented its 3mm-thick 11-inch OLED TV ‘XEL-1’ during KES 2007. Supporting a dramatic 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio, it offers 960 x 540 resolution and a low 45W power consumption. Adopting its own technology ‘Super Top Emission’, the Sony OLED TV features USB, LAN interface, 1x HDMI port, headphone plug and S-Force sound. Suggested price is around 1,000,000(KRW).
